Cholesterol levels are also critical. Excessive cholesterol levels can lead to the buildup of plaques along blood 
vessels, resulting in restricted blood flow and leading to hypertension, peripheral vascular and artery disease, and 
cardiomyopathies, and can cause embolizing events in the body. Table 11.6 outlines ranges of cholesterol 
measurements and their meanings (Johns Hopkins Medicine, 2023a).
